crossRefs.note: Praise Yahweh, you angels of his, who are mighty in strength, who fulfill his word, obeying the voice of his word.
He makes his messengers winds, and his servants flames of fire.
My God has sent his angel, and has shut the lions’ mouths, and they have not hurt me; because as before him innocence…
and to give relief to you who are afflicted with us, when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with his mighty angels…
But Michael, the archangel, when contending with the devil and arguing about the body of Moses, dared not bring against…

translations.web: whereas angels, though greater in might and power, don’t bring a railing judgment against them before the Lord.
translations.bsb: Yet not even angels, though greater in strength and power, dare to bring such slanderous charges against them before the Lord.
translations.kjv: Whereas angels, which are greater in power and might, bring not railing accusation against them before the Lord.
translations.asv: whereas angels, though greater in might and power, bring not a railing judgment against them before the Lord.
